What still needs a human check

  • Match the report’s serial ending to the Mac at handover.
  • Confirm any organization has released the Mac.
  • Agree how to check erasure, online activation and setup before payment.
  • Check physical condition and the hardware functions that matter to you.

No pass badge is issued. Unknown values remain unknown.

Review the shareable JSON

    

    
A few things to know.
Can a website check MDM or Activation Lock by itself?
No. An ordinary web page cannot read these Mac system settings. The downloadable script reads the Mac locally; this page explains the result.
Does “not enrolled” guarantee the Mac is clear forever?
No. This is the local status at collection time. Organization assignment, ownership, a possible bypass and behavior after a reset require separate evidence. A report can also be edited by its sender.
Does this replace testing at pickup?
It can reduce uncertainty and help plan a shorter meetup. It does not replace the checks you agree with the seller. The collector never erases the Mac or changes any security setting.
Where does my information go?
The page has no report-upload endpoint, analytics or third-party scripts. Imported reports stay in this tab. You can explicitly download a reviewed file and share it through your own conversation.
